legacy_import_policy: Historical W/O/H evidence is recorded without retroactive promotion. A historical_record node preserves scope and boundary but grants no new integration/evolution authority. If an immutable record has not yet landed on this branch's base tree, the node must carry a resolvable evidence_pointers entry plus authoritative result identity; such a node remains promotion-ineligible until the preservation record lands in the required mainline order.

nodes.supported_scope: Public home-life evidence predicts some cross-environment portable performance in the registered deterministic skill-practice architecture.
nodes.known_boundary: Not a general foundation-model cognition claim; replication was heterogeneous across Fields.

nodes.supported_scope: Public life-history evidence can identify useful portable competence under registered response-time constraints.
nodes.known_boundary: Does not outperform perfect-foreknowledge equal-development comparison and is sensitive to mission drift.

nodes.supported_scope: Registered recruited swarms outperformed the best recruited individual in discovery and replication.
nodes.known_boundary: Independent relationship-capital contribution from the W3 proxy did not replicate.

nodes.supported_scope: Repeated fixed-pair experience produced partner-specific, context-bound productive coordination effects under W4.
nodes.known_boundary: The effect was not context-free; renamed coordination contexts removed transfer.
W5 produced a replicated null/equivalence-class result and learned routing could be harmful.

nodes.supported_scope: Preserving an intact PairModule retained value relative to resetting the same members in discovery and replication.
nodes.known_boundary: This is retention/transfer of the same intact social unit, not fresh-substrate reproduction; one-member replacement inheritance was null/negative and higher-order composition was not robustly established.

nodes.supported_scope: Destination-acquired agent-owned portable learning returned home and improved source frontier under W6.
nodes.known_boundary: PairModule mobility route consistency did not replicate across all Fields.

nodes.supported_scope: A public marginal-source-cost estimator showed calibrated predictive value under W9 discovery and replication.
nodes.known_boundary: Using criticality as a hard allocation constraint protected sources while collapsing too much organization service.

nodes.supported_scope: Structured bounded retrieval surfaced relevant evidence that a recency-based flat suffix missed under the registered equal record budget.
nodes.known_boundary: Does not establish graph-database information superiority; O2 found complete flat-log parity for registered queries.

nodes.supported_scope: Structured historical evidence preserved predecessor information across complete member turnover under H2.
nodes.known_boundary: Registered deterministic task mechanism; broader schema/model generalization not established by H2 alone.

nodes.supported_scope: Accumulating structured history improved later complete-turnover generations in the registered deterministic cumulative-history mechanism.
nodes.known_boundary: Synthetic deterministic mechanism; naturalistic and cross-model scope not established.

nodes.supported_scope: Fresh stochastic successors with no predecessor conversation state used bounded structured accumulating history better than registered controls under H4.
nodes.known_boundary: One stochastic model/provider line and registered task family; no broad institutional mediation claim.
H5 persistent institutional mediation did not beat equal-compute direct, roles-only, or governed-static controls.

nodes.supported_scope: H6 observed a positive task-relevant compiled-state contrast on its registered routine-transfer panel.
nodes.known_boundary: The overall H6 mechanism failed its jointly required irrelevant-state-burden gate, and the H7 fresh-unit confirmatory routing test reversed the relevant-state effect.
H7 selective routing produced 27/48 versus 37/48 no-state correctness on the registered fresh routine primary, with all non-scientific gates passing.

nodes.status_provenance: H8 was motivated by inspected H5-H7 failures/heterogeneity and therefore originated as posthoc_motivated. Its transition to proposed is recorded here from immutable outcome-preceding records that satisfied the governance transition before any H8 provider outcome existed; this is not a result-based promotion.
nodes.scientific_question: Which transformations of accumulated historical evidence remain usable by fresh successors under novelty, and does a verified non-interpretive institutional shell preserve the raw structured-history effect?

proposal_transition_record.distinct_causal_intervention: Five-arm matched representation-boundary experiment isolating non-interpretive shell, role/chair synthesis, typed History IR, and compiled semantic state under equal three-call compute.
proposal_transition_record.fresh_data_commitment: 384 unique matched confirmatory units, 96 per four new reasoning families, development/confirmatory identity-disjoint.
proposal_transition_record.sample_size_and_statistical_contract: Prospectively frozen paired n=384; P1 90% conditional-Wilson equivalence CI; P2-P4 exact McNemar plus 95% conditional-Wilson paired-risk-difference CIs.
proposal_transition_record.sibling_multiplicity_plan: P2-P4 formed one preregistered Holm family at FWER 0.05; secondary family decompositions could not rescue a registered contrast.

nodes.scientific_question: Can a capability developed through experience in Environment A be prospectively characterized and deliberately reproduced in a fresh Environment B?
